notes.title: Update 0.90.3

The following fixes have been made.

notes.title: Update 0.90.2
notes.notes:
The following fixes have been made.

- The duration condition for the action "Taunt" has been changed.
Before: Effective until one battle.
After: Effective for one turn.

- The English name of the action "Cloud's Fury" was incorrect and has been corrected.
Incorrect: Cloud's Protection
Correct: Cloud's Fury

- In the following stages, it was possible to change the initial placement of units that should not be able to be changed in the story, so this has been fixed.
>STAGE 23
>EX 1
>EX 3

- Other minor bugs have been fixed.

notes.title: Update 0.90.1
notes.notes:
The following fixes have been made.

- The range of "Psycho Smash" has been changed to 1-2.
  The stats have also been adjusted to reflect the range change.

- Fixed an issue where "Sonic Shot" could not be used as a counterattack.

- The following accessories were not performing as described in their descriptions, so they have been corrected to function as described.
>Lapel pin of DEX
>Lapel pin of MND

- The following accessories were not performing as described in their descriptions.
Their effects have been improved.
>Lapel pin of Murakumo

- The following accessories are now displayed as items in the Shop.
>Omamori for DEF
>Omamori for DEF+

- Fixed an issue where English text was displayed incorrectly in some UI elements.

notes.title: [Major Update] Part 2 "Blue Octave" released! 30% off sale now on!
notes.notes: [p]The modern-day Japanese simulation RPG "Dramatic Road: Wind's Origin" released a major update, version 0.90, on August 2nd, Japan time. [/p][p][/p][p]To celebrate this major update, we will be holding a 30% off sale until August 15th, Japan time.[/p][p][/p][p]Version 0.90 adds a variety of new features, including the main scenario of Part 2, "Blue Octave."[/p][p][/p][p]\[Major Updates][/p][p]- Stages 14-26 have been added.[/p][p]- A new difficulty level, "Normal," has been added. The difficulty level can be changed at any time from the "Options" menu during intermissions.[/p][p]- The name of the previous "Standard" difficulty level has been changed to "Tactical."[/p][p]- New playable units have been added.[/p][p]- "Extra Maps" have been added. Extra Maps are a type of free map that allow new units to join upon completion.[/p][p]- The level cap for allied units has been raised to 29.[/p][p]- Many new actions/skills have been added that allied units can acquire by leveling up.[/p][p]- Significant adjustments have been made to action/skill performance. Due to this change, when loading save data from version 0.83 or earlier, the learned/enhanced state of actions will be initialized. All AcP consumed during initialization will be refunded.[/p][p]- Fixed some UI behavior.[/p][p]- Fixed various bugs.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43637055/74da38796a6aa974361059162fa472589053dbe1.png"][/img][/p][p]We will continue to work hard on updates for the official release.[/p][p]If you have any requests regarding the game, please contact us.[/p][p]Reviews/Discussions, please send us your requests![/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Part 2 Release Announcement
notes.notes: [p]We apologize for the long wait.[/p][p]We are happy to announce that the release date for Part 2 has been confirmed.[/p][p][/p][p]Next week \[Saturday, August 2nd at midnight](JST), we will be implementing the version 0.90 update,[/p][p]and releasing the second part of the story, "Blue Octave."[/p][p][/p][p]In the next update, in addition to adding a new scenario map,[/p][p]we will raise the level cap for player units,[/p][p]add new playable units,[/p][p]add new strengthening elements,[/p][p]and enhance various aspects of the game.[/p][p][/p][p]We are currently working hard on the final adjustments for release,[/p][p]so please look forward to the update date![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43637055/516ce172836c9f563f02be59de5b882e00bb23f3.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43637055/74da38796a6aa974361059162fa472589053dbe1.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43637055/873e75818f1ff3a1c5e985b3a5dff361522ee018.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: "Dramatic Road : the origin of wind" Notice of change in official release date
notes.notes:
■Regarding the Postponement of the Official Release

We had originally aimed to officially release the SRPG Dramatic Road: the origin of wind, currently available in early access, by the end of 2024. However, due to the time needed for improving quality in various areas exceeding our expectations, it has become difficult to complete the third part within this year.

As a result, we have decided to postpone the official release to 2025.

We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience and for keeping those of you who have been patiently awaiting the official release waiting even longer.


■Regarding the Release of "Part 2"

On the other hand, we plan to implement the Version 0.90 update and release "Part 2" in January 2025.

Initially, we aimed to release both Part 2 and Part 3 simultaneously. However, considering the current situation, we have decided that it would not be right to delay any further without adding to the main story.

With the implementation of Part 2, most of the characters who have yet to appear will become playable, and you will be able to enjoy more advanced battles and character development compared to Part 1. Please look forward to it!


Once the release date for the Version 0.90 update is confirmed, we will notify you accordingly.

We will continue to work diligently on the implementation and updates as we move toward completion. We greatly appreciate your continued support.

【Important Notices】
With this major change in action specifications,
When loading save data from Ver 0.54 or earlier in an environment of Ver 0.60 or later,
A process that initializes the action learning status of all ally units will work.
At this time, all consumed AcP will be returned.

Please note that this process also occurs when loading data during battle.

We apologize for any inconvenience caused to players due to the revised specifications.
I am very sorry.

------------------------------------------------

notes.title: "Dramatic Road the origin of wind" Released early access version today!
notes.notes:
Modern Japan Simulation RPG "Dramatic Road the origin of  wind"
Today we released the early access version!

To celebrate the release, we are having a 15% discount sale for a week!
If you are interested in SRPG, please take this opportunity to pick up this work!

In this work, we talk about three years of fierce battles between boys and girls in a three-part story.

The early access version includes "Part 1: Murakumo Alliance".
The following two and three parts will be added in the official release version.


We would like to hear your play feedback to make the game even better.
If you have any comments or concerns, please post them in the community!
